sn35.112:1.1: Rūpe bhikkhāve ānabhijānaṃ aparijānam avirājayam appajaham abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || Sadde || Gandhe || Rase || Phoṭṭhabbe || Dhamme anabhijānam aparijānam avirājayam appajaham abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || Rūpe ca kho bhikkhave abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayam pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || Sadde || Gandhe || Rase || Phoṭṭhabbe || Dhamme abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayam pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti || ||
